job_function: collateral management / margin operations analyst (SIMM IM reconciliation and disputes)
control_point: Initial margin differences above the dispute threshold are investigated and resolved against the counterparty's figure, and reported where the regime requires.

citations.source_name: ISDA Standard Initial Margin Model (SIMM) methodology, public documentation
17 CFR 23.502 and 23.504(b)(4) (CFTC uncleared swap margin dispute reporting)
Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) No 149/2013 (EMIR risk mitigation), Art. 15

consequence_anchor.public_source: CFTC and EMIR dispute-reporting and reconciliation obligations: public enforcement records document failures to investigate, resolve or report margin disputes
consequence_anchor.magnitude_band: qualitative: remediation and operational exposure; enforcement penalties vary by materiality and duration

commonality_rationale: Every in-scope uncleared derivatives counterparty using SIMM or an approved initial-margin model must reconcile IM figures and resolve or escalate disputes; CFTC and EMIR dispute-reporting rules apply market-wide.
